label: Checkpoint workers at the positions Nusrat sent (AUDIT.md 16.26 item 1, 2026-11-19). SIMULATOR ONLY. Read by run_t3_v4.py --checkpoints and hri_sim_v4.plan_checkpoints; checkpoints.json (the provisional layout of 16.23 / 16.25.1) is kept for the reproduction of 16.25.1.1 until the reruns of 16.26 decide.

source.note: read in place from ~/Downloads; 7 rows, none on J1 to J2 or J2 to J4. s_m = distance along the branch from the junction to the spot (the point of the road abeam the worker), right_m = the worker's offset to the right of the travel direction (negative = left), anchor = the spot, x z = the worker.

fraction_note: Unused where `positions` has the branch (the spot is the anchor); kept so that the older keys of the file format stay valid.
rule: Each worker stands at (x, z); the robot's spot is the anchor, the point of the road abeam the worker (lie_detection.checkpoint_s_m: the junction plus s_m along the branch). The robot asks from the spot by the v3 approach rule: 2.0 m from the worker on the line to them, i.e. 2.0 m across, the worker seen at 90 degrees to the road (so a BACK along the road is at 90 degrees from the camera). The junction workers (A4 and B4: drawn at random) are placed around these fixed workers.
